newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian share futures unmoved on budget.
newsitem.headline: Australian share futures unmoved on budget.

text.p: The Australian June Share Price Index (SPI) contract was little moved in response to the Federal Budget, traders said.
The contract was trading at 2,543 on the Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE), four points weaker than its late afternoon official close
This fall had been struck during the extended trading session and just before the budget was unveiled at 7.30 p.m. (0930 GMT).

The broker said the little trade there had been in the SPI contract since the release of the budget suggested that it was unlikely to have a significant effect on the physical market when it reopens on Wednesday.
